learningOutcomes:
PO1: Kien thurc khoa hoc xa hoi va nhan van, nghe thuat, kinh te, chinh tri va phap luat, kien thurc nen tang truyen thong ky thuat so va kien thirc chuyen sau truyen thong da phuong tien de de ap dung trong nhieu boi canh khac nhau dap urng yeu cau cong viec.
PO2: Nang luc sang tao noi dung va nghe thuat, nang lyc quan tri va kinh doanh san pham truyen thong, ung dung cong nghe thong tin va trang thiet bi ky thuat trong linh vyc truyen thong da phuong tien da phuong tien. Phat trien va hoan thien nhung ky nang can thiet cho tuong lai nham gia tang sy thanh cong va cai thien trien vong nghe nghiep trong the givi viec lam nganh truyen thong nhieu bién dong.
PO3: Kha nang lam viec doc lap, lam viec theo nhom, tu duy sang tao, tinh than trach nhiem, hop tac, giup do moi nguoi trong cong viec, ton trong to churc cong dong va ky nang giao tiép hieu qua de co the thich nghi voi moi truong lam viec day thir thach va luon tuan theo nhung chuan myc dao durc trong moi trurong cong viec. 2. Vi tri viec lam cua nguoi hoc sau khi tot nghiep: Sinh vien tot nghiep nganh Truyen thong da phuong tien co co hoi tham gia lam viec trong tat ca nhung linh vurc co sur dung san pham truyen thong (bao chi thong tin, cong nghiep sang tao, giao duc, giai tr,truyen thong chot chuc va doanh nghiep, quan he cong chung, marketing, quang cao...). Sinh vien cung co kha nang ty hoat dong kinh doanh chuyen ve san xuat san pham truyen thong. Cu the, trong cong tac san xuat san pham truyen thong, sinh vien tot nghiep nganh Truyen thong thong da phuong tien se co kha nang dam nhiem cac vi tri don cir sau day: Chuyen vien dieu phoi san xuat san pham truyen thong (production coordinator, production assistant,production executive); Bien tap vien, bien kich, tac gia, copywriter; Chuyen vien dieu phoi ky thuat (ky thuat thu hinh, thu tieng, dung, ky xao, phat hanh...) 4.
